description: This file contains utility functions for handling file uploads in the Playwright testing framework, including size checks, preparing files for upload, and managing file buffers.

methods.name: filesExceedUploadLimit
methods.description: Checks if the total size of given files exceeds the upload limit of 50MB.

methods.name: prepareFilesForUpload
methods.description: Prepares files for upload by validating paths, reading file buffers if needed, and creating payloads.
